protocol.purpose: One final opportunity assessment, not a deployment selection or independent confirmation
protocol.outer: Reuse the exact frozen target-specific 5-fold x 2-repeat partitions, seed 2026
protocol.inner: 3-fold stratified, seed 2026 + outer fold; maximize raw inner OOF ROC-AUC - 0.25 * Brier, identical to baseline

fixed.elastic_net: saga, max_iter=10000, tol=0.0001; original fold-local imputation/scaling/one-hot
fixed.hist_gradient_boosting: 100 iterations, learning_rate=0.04, min_samples_leaf=20, early_stopping=False; original fold-local preprocessing; no class weighting
fixed.catboost: 1.2.8; 150 iterations, learning_rate=0.04, boosting_type=Ordered, loss_function=Logloss, thread_count=2, random_seed=2026, allow_writing_files=False; native categorical inputs, no class weighting or eval_set
fixed.calibration: Fixed sigmoid, 3-fold training-only calibration, ensemble=False; no method search
fixed.features: All 55 eligible original inputs; no target-derived features, label repair, selection or engineered clinical cutoffs

protocol.primary_policy: Original six candidates plus these eight; family and parameters chosen exclusively by inner scores
protocol.secondary: All three new families, each inner-tuned; descriptive only, never select a family by its outer results
protocol.aggregation: Repeat-averaged OOF probabilities, one row per patient; also report each repeat and all ten paired fold differences
protocol.uncertainty: 2000 paired patient-stratified bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF predictions; conditional, overlapping training data, omits retraining and development selection uncertainty; no independent-fold significance tests
protocol.opportunity_flag: Descriptive only: AUC delta >= 0.02 with Brier delta <= 0.005 and AUC improves in >=7/10 folds; OR Brier delta <= -0.01 with AUC delta >= -0.005 and Brier improves in >=7/10 folds. Report paired intervals regardless.
protocol.deployment: Preserve every production artifact regardless of results. No automatic promotion, no selection of model family/features/calibration/thresholds using outer labels.
protocol.stop: Run this declared batch once. No adaptive grid expansion, new seeds, second search, or outcome-selected ensembles. Archive negative trial evidence for transparency; do not integrate rejected models into the app.
